We need to find a template that when applied to the given molecule (the target) reproduces the forward reaction described: carbonyl-ene reaction intramolecular forming a five-membered ring, converting ketone and alkene to hydroxyl and new C-C bond.

We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id (integer). We need to search for appropriate template. The search returned empty list with our criteria. Maybe need different criteria: bonds broken/formed format expects "6-6" etc. Could search just functional groups broken/formed. Already did, got empty. Maybe need to search without functional groups, just generic? Could try search with functional_groups_broken ["ketones"] only.
